description: Change one maintenance window's name, schedule, scope or monitors, or switch it off with enabled false; only the fields you pass change. While a window is in effect its monitors keep being checked, but no incident opens and no down or change alert goes out; a recovery alert goes out only for an incident whose down alert was already sent before the window began. Certificate and domain warnings still go out. A recurring window cannot become one-time: delete it with delete_maintenance_window and create a new one. Check a new schedule with preview_maintenance_window first. Requires a key with the write scope. An invalid argument is a 422 and a resulting schedule that is invalid (for example a bad rrule) a 406, each with the reason. A window with plan_disabled_at set was switched off by a plan drop: any update of it is refused (403) until the plan has room, and a successful one switches it back on. Returns the window. Example: {"window_id": "<id from list_maintenance_windows>", "enabled": false}

dtstart.description: The first start, an ISO 8601 date-time in the wall-clock time of timezone, for example 2026-10-14T22:00:00, in the years 2000 to 2100. A UTC offset or Z is a 422.

duration_minutes.description: How long each occurrence lasts, 1 to 40320 minutes.

enabled.description: false keeps the window but stops it silencing alerts.

monitor_ids.description: Replaces the list when passed. Monitor uuids from list_monitors, at least one when scope is MONITOR, at most 10,000. An id that is not a monitor of this organization is a 404. A deleted monitor the window already has may be resent. A window stored with more than 10,000 accepts the same set again, or one no larger, up to 20,000 ids per call.

rrule.description: Repeats the window: one iCal RRULE without the RRULE: prefix, at most 1024 characters, for example FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=SU;BYHOUR=3. Refused: hourly, minutely and secondly frequencies, more than 8 start times a day, a rule that never occurs, a part given twice, and a COUNT that takes too long to count (use a smaller COUNT or UNTIL). UNTIL is local in timezone, or UTC with a final Z; a date alone includes that whole day.

scope.description: ORG covers every monitor of the organization and ignores monitor_ids; MONITOR covers only monitor_ids.

timezone.description: IANA zone name such as Europe/Berlin, at most 64 characters. The schedule repeats in it, so a weekly 03:00 stays 03:00 across daylight-saving changes.

window_id.description: The window's uuid from list_maintenance_windows. An id that is not a window of this organization is a 404.

name: update_maintenance_window

active_until.description: When the occurrence in effect now ends (UTC); null when the window is not in effect, which a disabled or plan-disabled one never is.

monitors.description: The linked monitors by name, without deleted ones; monitor_ids keeps them. Empty for an ORG window without links, though it covers every monitor.

type.description: Known values: HTTP, PING, SSL, TCP, DNS.

title: Update a maintenance window
